answer: No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 53 identities per epoch. Audits are recorded in lagoon, queued in atlas, and nectar publishes the wait time. A farm of 362 fresh keys hence waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. A farm of 1362 identities would post 4441 proofs and burn roughly 48 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
